title: Travelling by Train and Plane
text:
Many people travel by train. A train is fast and comfortable. In big cities, people often take the bus or the metro to work. The metro is usually very quick.

Last summer, my family flew to Italy by plane. We took a taxi from the airport to our hotel. The taxi driver was very friendly. We enjoyed the trip a lot.

questions.text: What do people often take to work in big cities?
How did the family travel to Italy?
How did the family probably feel about their trip?
What can we infer about the taxi driver?
options: He was kind to the family.
He was angry at the family.
He did not speak to the family.

vocabulary.definition: pleasant to sit or stay in, without pain or stress
an underground railway system in a city
kind and pleasant to other people
a place where planes take off and land

paragraph_translations: Wiele osób podróżuje pociągiem. Pociąg jest szybki i wygodny. W dużych miastach ludzie często jeżdżą autobusem albo metrem do pracy. Metro jest zwykle bardzo szybkie.
W zeszłe lato moja rodzina poleciała samolotem do Włoch. Z lotniska pojechaliśmy taksówką do hotelu. Kierowca taksówki był bardzo przyjazny. Bardzo podobała nam się ta podróż.
